title: Strict tensor augmentation computes the balanced scalar transpose
statement: Fix l,E and an arbitrary scheme X with the completed coefficient ring and strict system calculus [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Let ringed be a representative-normalized RingedModels presentation [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], and P,Q good flat-term K-flat complexes [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined]. The composite of the ordinary tensor representative, the reconstruction unit, total limit of the tensorClosed-transported balanced reductionTensor map, and the full reference tensor Roos model [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison] equals Q of the chain augmentation specified by ringed.tensor.chain [def-sf-tensor-completion-comparison]. This is a good-complex transpose computation only; no invertibility or arbitrary-object descent is asserted.

source.place: Maps-used sentence, primitive tensor/pullback coefficient comparison and open-factor normalization.

proof.text: By the proved uniqueness of the strict tensor augmentation, tensor.canonical.1 identifies the supplied natural chain with StrictTensorAugmentation.map, using all first pure-tensor coordinates and the zero shifted coordinate.

The existing IntegralAmbient.tensor_good theorem shows that the signed total tensor of two good complexes is good. Apply tensorReduction_ordinaryModel to obtain the coherent system square and the finite chain component equation. Apply tensorReduction_ordinaryTranspose to that finite equation to identify the ordinary chain transpose with the strict quotient augmentation.

Use the adjunction-normalized reductionModel equation, naturality of the ordinary-to-derived limit unit, and pullbackTensorLimitUnit_roos to compute the derived transpose of the localized strict chain psi. This argument works for any good source and any strict target complex, before the tensor specialization.

Naturality of the reconstruction unit for the ordinary representative moves that representative inside reduction and limit. Functoriality combines it with tensorClosed, and tensorRepresentative identifies their composite with the calculus tensor representative. Expand the full reference model, combine limit maps, and substitute the coherent system square. The generic transpose calculation and localization of the ordinary chain equation finish.

theorem tensorQuotientTranspose_onGood
    (ringed : IntegralSystemRealization.RingedModels l E) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E X).FullSubcategory) :
    (ringed.tensor X).ordinary.representative.hom.app
        (⟨P.obj, P.property⟩, ⟨Q.obj, Q.property⟩) ≫
      (IntegralSystemRealization.calculus l E X).adjunction.unit.app
        ((ringed.tensor X).ordinary.tensor.obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj)) ≫
      (coefficientSequenceLimit l E X).map
        ((IntegralSystemRealization.calculus l E X).reduction.map
          (eqToIso (congrArg (fun T ↦ T.obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj))
              (ringed.tensorClosed X))).hom ≫
          (IntegralSystemRealization.calculus l E X).reductionTensor.hom.app
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj)) ≫
      (pullbackTensorReferenceTensorModel l E X P Q).hom =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((ringed.tensor X).chain.app (P.obj, Q.obj))
